check_for_package_update.description: Compare the version you have against what nuget.org publishes now. Answers whether there is an update, whether it is a major, minor or patch step, how many releases and how many days behind you are, and whether the version you are on is deprecated or has a known security advisory, all in one step, with a sentence ready to send. This is the action for a scheduled dependency check. No API key required.

Give it the version you ship and it answers whether that exact version is affected, by what, how severe it is, and the lowest release that is not, rather than handing back a version range for somebody to read. description: Read nuget.org, the public gallery for .NET packages, from a workflow. Search all 400,000+ packages by name, owner, tag or kind, read a package's metadata, licence, owners and README, and walk its release history with each version's date, downloads and size. Open a single release for the frameworks it targets, what it depends on, and the repository and exact commit it was built from. Check a version against nuget.org's security advisories and get the lowest safe release to move to, or compare the version you ship against what is published now and get a sentence saying how far behind you are. Every action reads: nothing here publishes, unlists or changes anything on nuget.org. No account or API key required.
